results.title: HiringNow Review 2026: I Ran My Job Search on It for a Week
results.content:
It is less essential if you are applying to one or two dream roles. In that case, the free plan's 10 auto-applies and the tailoring tools may be all you need.

If you only need a resume builder rather than a job agent, our roundup of the best resume builders compares the main options, and our FlowCV review covers a strong free pick.

## The verdict

After a week, HiringNow earned a place in my job search. It found relevant jobs within hours of posting, scored them honestly, and tailored my resume without inventing anything.

The receipts and the clear Auto Apply queue earned my trust, which matters for any tool that sends applications in your name. Its newness is my only caveat, and the free plan lets you try it with nothing to lose.

Posted by

rohith reddyRohith

LinkedInX [...] ResumeGPT. A chat assistant that builds, tailors and reviews your resume in plain conversation.
 Optimize your LinkedIn. AI tips to get your profile ready for the jobs you want.
 Mock interviews. Practice with an AI interviewer and get feedback (currently in beta).
 Chrome extension. Autofill applications you start on other sites.
 Documents hub. Resumes, cover letters, resignation letters and contacts in one place.

HiringNow ResumeGPT assistant ready to answer resume, LinkedIn and interview questions

ResumeGPT answers questions about your resume, LinkedIn, interviews and job search.

## HiringNow pricing

Every plan includes job matching and a tailored resume per application. The paid tiers differ mainly in how many auto-applies you get each month. [...] I would rather use a tool that tells me a role is a reach than one that calls everything a perfect fit. It meant my applications went to the jobs that suited me best.

Found a job somewhere else? Paste the posting link from Workday, Greenhouse, Lever or Ashby, and HiringNow indexes and scores it like the rest.

## Tailored resumes for every application

HiringNow's AI Resume Builder rewrites your resume for each job description in an ATS-friendly template. Its rule is strict: it rewords experience you already have and adds nothing you did not write.

That is the right call. A tailored resume that invents skills gets you an interview you cannot pass, while one that reorders and rephrases real experience gets you past the screen honestly.

HiringNow vs. the usual ways

## The job search that works for you,not the other way around. [...] ### What is an AI job search agent?

An AI job search agent is software that runs the repetitive parts of a job search for you. It finds new jobs, matches them to your profile, tailors your resume to each job description, and applies to jobs automatically within rules you set. You may also see it called an AI job search tool, assistant or copilot. The difference from a job board or a chat assistant is that an agent acts: HiringNow's agent finds the very relevant jobs to your profile, tailor resumes, and fills out the employer's own application form after you approve.
